## Semantic Versioning and Release Channels

wiki-forge follows strict Semantic Versioning (SemVer 2.0.0). Every pipeline
run is tagged against a release channel -- `stable`, `beta`, or `nightly` --
and the `wiki-forge release` command promotes a build across channels with an
automated changelog and a signed version manifest. Breaking changes to node
schemas bump the MAJOR version and trigger the deprecation-window policy.
rationale: Documents the project's versioning and release-channel regime so contributors know how builds are promoted.
